correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the edge-two icosahedron, uniformly sampled viewing normal, precise Cauchy brightness normalization and every threshold in the closed interval. A self-contained exact arithmetic certificate checks twenty supporting triangular faces, thirty edge adjacencies, ten antipodal generators and all 1024 signs in 18 complete norm levels, with exactly 20 top normals. Independently checked algebra gives B_+²=42+18 sqrt(5), B_1²=42+14 sqrt(5), B_1²/B_+²>(1+sqrt(5)/3)/2 and >8/9. These control cap disjointness and six-silhouette cells. Integration of 20 spherical caps divided by 4pi proves the survival function for all real t in range. Three deterministic 65,536-view numerical diagnostics and 300 independently calculated planar convex-hull projection areas corroborate but do not substitute for the exact proof. At the lower endpoint, isolated second-level directions have zero spherical measure.
